name: std::flat_map<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::rbegin, std::flat_map<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::crbegin
intro: Returns a reverse iterator to the first element of the reversed flat_map. It corresponds to the last element of the non-reversed flat_map. If the flat_map is empty, the returned iterator is equal to rend().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reverse iterator to the first element.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The underlying iterator of the returned reverse iterator is the end iterator. Hence the returned iterator is invalidated if and when the end iterator is invalidated.
